g.text: Round a required time upward to the next permitted boundary.

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: For alternating turns, first add the playback reserve to ready time,

text.style: font-size: 13px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: then count whole bar intervals from capture end to that boundary.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: g: boundary spacing; phi: offset; x: required time. tau: bar duration; t_cap: capture end.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: F_elig: allowed prepared response ready; M_sink: reserve; N_wait: whole intervals. All times: ms.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: At 90 BPM, tau = 2,666.667 ms per bar.

text.style: font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735
font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Response ready at F_elig = 6,200 ms; reserve = 200.

g.text: Here g = tau and phi = t_cap. Use exact bar duration.

text.style: font-size: 11.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #566171

g.text: The 5.333-s boundary is too early; the next is 8.000 s.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #897132
font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: Even a small readiness delay can move the response by a whole bar. Replaying rhythm fills the wait.

text.style: font-size: 12px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #202735

g.text: N_wait includes transition time, not just echoes. Without a finite policy-eligible result, record no response.
